title: Powers under polynomial encoding
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive natural number, and let $m$ be a vector of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$ such that the monic polynomial $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$ is irreducible over $\mathbb{F}_2$. For every vector $r$ of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$ and every natural number $e$, encoding the result of raising $r$ to the $e$th power modulo this polynomial equals the $e$th power of the encoding of $r$ in the quotient algebra.
hypotheses_covered: irreducibility of the monic polynomial determined by $m$
